text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "At its meeting on 29 March, it decided, based on the lessons learned from the COVID-19 pandemic, to strengthen the organisation of the Federal Administration so it is better equipped for future crises.", "gist": "Decision made on March 29 to improve Federal Administration for future crises using COVID-19 lessons"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "In the event of complex crises, the Federal Council will be able to deploy crisis units at both a strategic and operational level.", "gist": "Federal Council can deploy crisis units at strategic and operational levels during complex crises"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The Federal Council remains the supreme governing authority.", "gist": "Federal Council retains its role as supreme governing authority"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "In addition, a Standing Core Unit will provide crisis management support to the departmental staff offices.", "gist": "A Standing Core Unit will support departmental staff offices with crisis management"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "The Federal Council has tasked the Federal Department of Defence, Civil Protection and Sport DDPS and the Federal Chancellery FCh with drawing up core legislation on the new crisis management structure by the end of 2023.", "gist": "Federal Council obliges DDPS and FCh to draft core legislation for new crisis management by end of 2023"}, {"type": "other", "quote": "Legal foundations", "gist": "Reference to legal basis for the measures"}]}
